scientific_integrity: Proof by alternating matching symmetric difference; finite exhaustive checker is supporting falsification evidence only. The full foundational 2018 article was inaccessible in this review, and this limits completeness of the literature comparison.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula optimizes cycle rank over even-cycle-free spanning subgraphs; it is not asserted to be polynomial-time evaluable. The classification holds for finite simple graphs; the Fibonacci count uses fixed labeled paths. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Odd-cactus obstructions to global forcing in one-leaf coronas
